entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Who the hell are you?
A gun enthusiast.
A gun customization guru.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...At your age?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Huh? You sure about that?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You look like a beginner to me...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Well, I guess you got the heart[n]of an enthusiast.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Heh, you're a strange one, kid.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Wait a sec.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *chuckle* Yeah, this could work.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Hey, I can grant that wish of yours...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: But you better have the money. [n]These things are worth hundreds[n]of thousands of yen per unit.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Sometimes they even reach the millions,[n]depending on how I feel.
I'm not sure I follow.
This sounds suspicious.
Just let me buy them already.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: S'that right?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You're not bluffin', are you, kid?[n]...Heh, it may actually make you[n]more useful if you are.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Look, I ain't a bad dude. I've been known[n]to compromise, from time to time.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: For example...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You help me out with my "business"...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Smugglin' goods, destroyin' evidence...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: And as a reward, I'll introduce you to the[n]special menu, with good prices for a punk[n]like you.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Whaddya say? Not bad, huh?
That's a terrible deal.
What's your goal here?
I'd rather not break the law.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You don't know what you're[n]talkin' about. This is a great deal.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's on a need-to-know basis,[n]and you don't need to know.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Ha! That's a good one. You tryin'[n]to act all innocent now?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Gotta fight evil with evil... [n]I need a pawn of my own.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Don't talk to no one about this.[n]Got it? Just follow my orders.
We won't be able to get much stronger[n]if I don't accept his offer...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Now what's it gonna be? You gonna take my[n]deal or not?
I'll do what I can.
If it's not too dangerous.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...That's fine.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Okay, I'll work on that special[n]menu for you.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You should be grateful.
I've made a deal with Iwai...
I should be able to ask him to[n]customize guns for me now, in[n]exchange for helping him out...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It seems you had model guns in your[n]possession as well. Their detail goes[n]beyond a simple hobby.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm sure some people believed those[n]guns were real. You'll tell me how[n]you procured them, won't you?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Spill it!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new contract.[n]Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your gun expertise shall increase[n]through this new bond of yours.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Oh, yeah. When I don't got any[n]business goin' on, I'll have you[n]do some miscellaneous chores.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Clean... Run errands... There's plenty[n]for you to do around here.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Must be pretty excitin' for an[n]enthusiast like you, huh?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...All right, that's enough for today.[n]Go on, get outta here.
